items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Cramp and his Jazz O'Maniacs... we rehearsed every week... Italian boys started to want to hire Charlie for their dances.

ctx.x: Charlie Cramp and his Jazz O'Maniacs.

And then this was a colored dance hall, but these Italian boys and all around St. Louis started to hear about this jazz and they started to come into this dance hall 'cause they could dance by this music. And boy, we had as many white as blacks. They almost took it over because they loved that music. And Charlie was reading about jazz, jazz, jazz, you know, they called it jazz o'maniacs. That was the name -- and we rehearsed every week, once a week, and from then on why the Italian boys started to want to hire…
